verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser runs AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions that start with a single API call and execute on their own without local infrastructure. Profiles persist state across runs, and recordings let you review what happened afterward. However, the evidence shows no built-in way to schedule, trigger, or set up recurring background automations, so users must build that orchestration themselves. Missing for 10: native scheduling/cron or event triggers, webhook/notification on completion, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended long-running automations.
